name: Skip Ahead
author: Dennis Ranke
description: Bounce your ball from tile to tile along a 3D track and skip ahead as far as you can without falling off.

descriptions.en: Bounce your ball from tile to tile along a 3D track and skip ahead as far as you can without falling off.
descriptions.it: Fai rimbalzare la pallina di piastrella in piastrella lungo un percorso 3D e vai avanti il più possibile senza cadere.
